Santorini's caldera views draw huge crowds in peak summer, and timing your visit differently can make the same trip feel entirely different.

## Shoulder season advantages

Late spring and early autumn bring warm weather without the crush of July and August, and hotel prices drop noticeably once the school holidays end.

## What changes in winter

Many restaurants and hotels close for the off-season, so a winter visit trades convenience for a much quieter, more local experience of the island.

## Getting the best sunset views

Oia is famous for sunset, but Imerovigli offers nearly identical views with a fraction of the crowd if you're willing to walk a little further from the main square.

Ferry schedules thin out considerably outside peak season, so anyone island-hopping around a shoulder-season Santorini trip should double-check connections before locking in a full itinerary.
